findings.summary: Later global Ledger appends invalidated historical Final Receipts
findings.resolution: Final Receipt now binds exact per-run OTester/OAudit entries and per-run head

findings.summary: OTester input was not verified against the regression evidence manifest
findings.resolution: Evidence manifests and OTester input digest are now directly verified

findings.summary: Historical fixture verification depended on the current repository fixture definition
findings.resolution: Each run now seals and verifies a fixture contract snapshot

findings.summary: Receipt JSON Schema and Java ReceiptEnvelope used different field structures
findings.resolution: Schema now exactly matches the Java record and consistency tests enforce it

findings.summary: Signing-key expiry and revocation invalidated historical valid receipts
findings.resolution: Key validity and revocation are evaluated at receipt issuance time

findings.summary: Final Receipt PASS could be produced while Critical and High finding status remained unknown
findings.resolution: A reviewed security finding snapshot is now required, fail-closed, Final-Locked and Final-Receipt-bound

findings.summary: Official read-only re-verification validated Source Lock format without rebinding the current repository source
findings.resolution: Official re-verification now checks commit, tracked tree, policy digest and clean worktree against the repository

findings.summary: Whole-run reproducibility compared evidence manifests containing run-specific absolute paths
findings.resolution: The gate compares underlying deterministic evidence while validating each manifest independently

findings.summary: Sealed Fixture and Security snapshots were not explicitly compared with their Source-Locked repository originals
findings.resolution: Finalization and official re-verification now require exact snapshot-to-repository byte equality
